name: agent-ready-repo
description: Keeps agent-facing repository memory layered, current, and maintainable across AGENTS.md, monorepos, docs, skills, agents, hooks, CLI, and MCP surfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Layered, current AGENTS.md, skills, agents, and hooks for any coding agent host.
interface.longDescription: Agent Ready Repo audits, designs, and maintains agent-facing repository memory. It produces evidence-backed plans for AGENTS.md, monorepo context layering, docs, skills, agents, hooks, CLI, MCP, and plugin manifests, and ships a non-editing drift reminder plus a preflight checker (--json) so the layout stays consistent across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other hosts.
capabilities: Audit AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and host-specific files for drift
Design focused skills and subagents with compatible frontmatter
Maintain layered monorepo agent context without duplication
Run a JSON preflight checker for common agent-ready issues
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's agent-facing memory and produce a layered remediation plan.
